change: State shared-subject task and independent support in opening; remove old membership question. Every other line and all masks unchanged from v16. No v18 social-media sentence.
hypothesis: Explicitly distinguishing shared subject from a group-wide summary reduces unsupported combined titles while preserving per-instance scope.
execution: First call alone; then waves of at most three. Fresh isolated process/thread/empty workspace per call. Stop new submissions on any failure. No automatic retries or best-of selection.
assessment: Read every title with all supplied masks. No exact-label matching. Apply approved strict per-instance subject support, meaning rather than wording/format, concision and one-title output. Preserve both trials, assistant uncertainty, and prior user decisions. Default review must expose all failures from both versions; separate access to uncertain outputs and complete results.
scope: No source/mask/vector/group edits, no model changes, no v19 testing, no additional prompt revisions, no freeze.
billing: Existing authorized Codex subscription only; no new API billing, purchases, rental or commitment.
